page.overview:
Who is Jane?

Jane is a last minute character that appears in Season 2. She is a worshiper of an ancient spirit known as Ka-Hor.

Together with her friend Riley, the two unearthed the tomb of Ka-Hor. There, Jane and Riley found the deceased father of the former who had also tried to revive Ka-Hor sometime ago and had been inadvertently trapped inside by Invincible. The two then encountered Ka-Hor himself who exuded a menacing presence before revealing his desire to possess a male host in order to escape his tomb, as well as his prejudice and disinterest in females. They were all then inadvertently sealed inside the tomb by Invincible again.

Several months later and during the Invincible War, a fight between the Immortal and an evil Invincible variant unearthed the tomb, allowing Riley to escape with a weakened Jane; the former only survived in peak condition thanks to her own abilities, and she quickly left to desert carrying Jane to get her aid.

Jane has straight blonde hair, often styled in a simple, natural way. She has a light to medium skin tone. Jane wears a casual but practical outfit for their journey to Ka-Hor, consisting of a jacket or coat over a simple top, along with pants or leggings, Jane has a beetle tattoo on her arm under her wrist.
